Location

Razachai Inner Sanctum, around here (33098, 31101, 14) or here (33044, 31089, 14).

Behaviour

Similar to a Ghastly Dragon. Hatebreeder? will retreat at 720 to 5399 (4% - 29.99%, red) health.

Strategy

The death attacks should be less effective if you wear a Death Ring or Koshei's Ancient Amulet. Depending on your vocation, you can use one of the following: Skullcracker Armor, Robe of the Underworld, Divine Plate. It's better to use energy-based attacks like Energy Wave. It heals very fast so it's a tough monster to solo. Also it spawns with more ghastly dragons.
